text: Film a 20-second nature-documentary narration, in a whisper, about a pigeon or any other bird in your city.
Take a selfie with the oldest-looking tree in the nearest park and give the tree a name in your caption.
Photograph a door in your city you'd love to live behind, and say in the caption who you imagine lives there now.
Film yourself holding a plank for 45 seconds somewhere you've never planked before (a park path, a stairwell, a campus corridor).
Draw a self-portrait with your non-dominant hand in under five minutes, then post one photo of the drawing held next to your face.
Photograph the most chaotic shelf of your fridge or kitchen cupboard exactly as it is, no tidying allowed.
Make a sandwich from three ingredients you've never combined before and film your first bite and honest reaction.
Film a 30-second tour of your room as a luxury real-estate agent trying to sell it for millions.
Film yourself trying to pronounce the longest street or station name you can find today, in one take.
Find the best piece of street art within walking distance and take a photo of yourself posing as if you're part of it.
Take a photo of the best view you can reach in 15 minutes on foot without paying anything.
Balance a spoon on your nose and film three attempts in one video. Your best time goes in the caption.
Shuffle your music, then film yourself lip-syncing with full drama to the first song that plays for 20 seconds.
Build a tower at least ten objects tall from things on your desk and photograph it right before it falls.
Film a 15-second weather report from your window in the style of an over-excited TV presenter.
Take an artistic photo of your reflection in a puddle, shop window or any shiny surface you find outside.
Write a haiku about your day so far on a scrap of paper and photograph it in the spot that inspired it.
Photograph a cloud that looks like something, and caption what you see in it.
Juggle any three soft objects for as long as you can and film it, fails included.
Photograph the oldest thing you own and tell its story in a one-sentence caption.
Film a 15-second unboxing of the most boring object in your bag, with maximum influencer hype.
Find the oldest date carved or written on a building near you and take a photo of it.
Film yourself walking 20 metres down a quiet pavement like it's a fashion-week runway.
Style your next meal like a dish at an expensive restaurant, photograph it, and give it a pretentious menu name in the caption.
Gather seven objects in rainbow order from wherever you are right now and take one photo of the line-up.
Film yourself trying to do a cartwheel, a handstand or a forward roll on soft grass in a park. Any attempt counts.
Find a bench with a plaque, a memorial or a dedication on it, photograph it, and tell us in the caption what it says.
Film a 20-second slow-motion video of yourself jumping into a pile of leaves, a patch of grass or onto the last step of a staircase.
Find a word written somewhere in your city that's funny when read in Czech or English, and photograph it.
Make the strangest face you can next to a statue in your city that has a similar expression, and take one photo of you both.
Photograph the smallest thing in your city that made you smile today.
Draw a map of your day so far from memory on paper and post a photo of it.
Film yourself drinking a glass of water in the most elegant, royal way possible.
Take a photo that makes an ordinary object near you look gigantic by playing with perspective.
Record a 30-second video of the sounds of your street with your eyes (and camera) pointed only at the sky.
Find something in your city that reminds you of a group member, photograph it, and say who it reminds you of in the caption.
Recreate the most recent photo another group member posted in the feed, as closely as you can, in your own city.
Film yourself recording a 15-second made-up song for a group member about their week, then actually send it to them.
Film a 20-second postcard video of the street you're on right now, narrated to a group member who has never been there.
Write one honest compliment for every group member on a single piece of paper and post a photo of it.
Photograph something in your kitchen that a group member would definitely judge you for, and tag them in the caption.
Do a 15-second affectionate impression of another group member without naming them and let the group guess who it is.
Photograph the spot in your city where you'd take a group member first if they visited this weekend, and say who and why.
Call a group member for at least five minutes just to ask about their day, and post a screenshot of the call length.
Hum a song the whole group knows for 15 seconds on video and let the others guess it in the comments.
Find a shop, street or café in your city that shares a name with a group member (or comes close), and take a selfie with the sign.
Ask a shop assistant which product in the shop is their personal favourite, and photograph it. No need to buy it.
Ask a stranger where to find the best bakery nearby, follow their directions, and post a photo of what you find.
Ask a cashier how their day is going and actually listen. Post a selfie afterwards with one thing you learned in the caption.
Compliment a stranger's dog, and if the owner says yes, take a photo of the dog.
Ask a stranger to take a photo of you doing your most dramatic model pose in a public spot.
Ask a stranger what they would recommend eating nearby, then photograph the dish or the place.
Ask a librarian for one book recommendation and take a photo of yourself holding the book.
Say hello in the local language to five people you pass, then post a selfie with how many said hello back.
Hold the door open for three people in a row and post a doorway selfie with your score in the caption.
Ask a stranger to rate your outfit from 1 to 10, then post a full-outfit photo with the score.
Ask a stranger to guess your age, then post a selfie with their guess in the caption.
Ask a stranger which star sign you look like and post a selfie with their verdict.
Ask a stranger which song they've had on repeat lately, then film yourself listening to it for the first time.
Ask a market vendor what's in season right now and photograph the fruit or vegetable they name.
Ask a stranger to teach you their favourite word in the local language, then film yourself saying it three times.
Ask a stranger whether they're a cat person or a dog person, then film a 20-second passionate defence of the other side.
Ask a stranger for a fist bump for good luck, then film your reaction straight afterwards.
Ask a shop worker for the strangest item they sell and photograph it.
Ask someone in a park for the best spot in that park, go there and take a photo.
Thank your bus or tram driver out loud as you get off, then post a selfie at the stop.
Ask a stranger to pick a number between 10 and 40, then film yourself doing that many jumping jacks.
Ask a stranger what they'd name a pet goldfish, then draw the goldfish with its name and photograph the drawing.
Ask a stranger to choose between two cheap snacks for you, then film yourself eating the winner and giving a verdict.
Ask a stranger for one film everyone should see, and post a photo of its title on your screen tonight.
Ask a stranger for their best one-sentence life advice, write it on paper and photograph it.
Ask a stranger to give you one word, and use that word in your caption without explaining it.
Ask a barista or shop worker for a fun fact about the neighbourhood, and photograph whatever the fact is about.
Ask a stranger which of two photos on your phone you should post today, then post the winner and say it was their pick.
Ask a stranger to recommend a café, go there and photograph your drink.
Ask a stranger to give you a nickname for today, and sign your caption with it.
Ask a student on campus what their favourite course is and why, then post a selfie with their answer in the caption.
Film yourself telling your worst dad joke to the camera, then tell it to a stranger and put their rating in the caption.
Ask a stranger to point at a random object nearby, then film a 15-second advert for that object.
Ask a florist or plant seller which plant is the hardest to kill, and photograph it.
Give a staff member (a cashier, cleaner or driver) a specific, genuine compliment, then post a selfie and tell us what you said.
Ask a stranger which direction to walk to find something interesting, follow it for ten minutes, and photograph what you find.
Ask a stranger how to say "have a nice day" in a language that is neither local nor your native one, and film yourself saying it.
Ask a stranger to pick an emotion, then film yourself acting it out for ten seconds like a soap-opera star.
Ask a stranger what they're most looking forward to this week, then post a selfie with their answer in the caption.
Ask someone at the gym how they would use a machine you've never tried, then film yourself doing three careful reps.
Ask a bookshop worker for the book they'd give a stranger as a gift, and photograph its cover.
Ask a stranger where they'd go if they had only one free afternoon in your city, and photograph that place if you can reach it today.
Ask a stranger where the best spot nearby is to watch the sunset, go there and post a photo of the sky.
Ask a stranger to show you a 5-second dance move, then film yourself doing it on your own straight afterwards.
Cook a full meal for about the price of two coffees and photograph it next to the receipt.
Walk to a neighbourhood of your city you've never been to and photograph the most interesting thing you find there.
Find your city's oldest café or bakery that's still open and take a photo in front of it or inside.
Film a 30-second interpretive dance about your week in a public park.
Sing a chorus of any song out loud while walking down a busy street and film it with the selfie camera.
Ride any tram, bus or metro line to its last stop and photograph the first interesting thing you see there.
Recreate a famous painting using yourself and things from your home, and post it.
Film a 60-second celebrity-chef cooking show while making a simple snack in your kitchen.
Write a four-line poem about your city and film yourself reading it aloud in a public square.
Film a 30-second air-guitar solo in a public place with full rock-star energy.
Learn a 15-second dance from a video and perform it on camera in a public place.
Bake something from scratch that you've never made before and photograph the result, however it turned out.
Build a little sculpture or picture using only things you find on the ground in a park, and photograph it.
Go to the nearest public library, find the oldest book you're allowed to hold, and take a photo of you with it.
Sketch a building in your city for at least 20 minutes, then take one photo of the sketch held up in front of the real building.
Spend one hour in a public place (a café, park or library) without touching your phone, then post a photo of something you noticed.
Film a 30-second live news report from a busy street about something completely ordinary happening there.
Walk a route that draws a shape (a heart, a star or your initial) on your fitness or map app, and post a screenshot of the route.
Try a food from a cuisine you've never eaten, from a cheap local place, and film your first bite.
Read a page of any book aloud in a dramatic theatre voice on a public bench, and film 30 seconds of it.
Wear your jacket or hoodie backwards for an hour while you go about your day, and post a photo of it in public.
Do 20 push-ups in a busy public place and film all of them.
Hold a superhero pose for 30 seconds in the busiest spot you can find, and film it.
Film yourself singing "Happy Birthday" to yourself out loud in a public place, even though it isn't your birthday.
Find ten things in your city that are shaped like letters, photograph them, and post one collage that spells a word.
Take a 30-minute walk without maps, choosing every turn by flipping a coin, and photograph where you end up.
Run or walk fast up the highest public staircase you can find and film the view (and your breathing) at the top.
Pick a song a group member loves, perform 20 seconds of it in a public place, and dedicate it to them in the caption.
Film a 60-second walking travel guide to your neighbourhood for a group member, as if they're arriving tomorrow.
Write a real postcard or short letter to a group member, post a photo of it before sending, and then actually post it.
Cook a dish that reminds you of a group member and post a photo with one sentence explaining why.
Ask a stranger to record a 10-second hello to one group member on your phone. Only post it if they say it's OK to share.
Ask a local to name one place a group member must see when they visit your city, go there today and photograph it.
Make a 30-second video tribute to the group's best inside joke using only things you find in your city today.
Ask a stranger to teach you a phrase in the local language that you didn't know, use it with a different stranger, and film yourself explaining how it went.
Interview a stranger for one minute like a TV reporter holding an imaginary microphone, and film it if they agree.
Ask a stranger for their favourite hidden spot in the city, go there today and take a selfie.
Order in a café or bakery using only a language that isn't your native one, then post a photo of what you got and how it went.
Ask three different strangers what they'd do with a free day in your city, and post a selfie with the best answer in the caption.
Ask a stranger to write a four-line poem about you on paper, and photograph the poem.
Ask a stranger to make up a 10-second dance for you, then perform it right there on camera.
Ask a stranger to teach you their handshake, and film the two of you doing it if they agree.
Ask a stranger to judge your best animal impression, film the impression, and put their score in the caption.
Pitch a ridiculous business idea to a stranger in one minute and ask whether they'd invest. Film your pitch to the camera and post their verdict.
Ask a stranger for the most mind-blowing fact they know, then film yourself retelling it.
Ask a street musician whether you can request a song and film 20 seconds of it if they agree.
Ask an older person on a park bench what the city was like when they were your age, and post the best line in your caption.
Sing a chorus to a stranger who agrees to listen, ask them to rate it, and film yourself singing it again afterwards.
Ask a stranger to take a candid-looking photo of you laughing hysterically at absolutely nothing.
Play best-of-three rock-paper-scissors with a stranger and film it if they're happy to be in the video.
Ask a stranger to draw you in 60 seconds and photograph the drawing.
Survey five strangers on one silly question (pineapple on pizza, socks with sandals) and post a hand-drawn chart of the results.
Ask a stranger to recommend a book, then read its first paragraph aloud to the camera in the library or bookshop (quietly, if it's a library).
Ask a stranger to set you a challenge that takes under a minute, then do it on camera.
Ask a shop worker to recommend the best local snack for very little money, buy it and film your review.
Ask a stranger to teach you to whistle with your fingers and film your attempts afterwards.
Ask a stranger to guess your job or field of study just by looking at you, and film yourself reacting to their guess.
Play a game of street chess, table tennis or basketball with a stranger in a park, and post a photo of the game if they agree.
Ask a stranger to help you pick the best angle for a photo of a building near you, and post the photo they chose.
Ask a stranger for directions, then film yourself repeating them in a dramatic movie-trailer voice.
Ask a stranger to teach you a tongue twister in their language and film yourself trying it.
Ask a stranger for their go-to karaoke song and film yourself singing 15 seconds of it.
Give three strangers specific, genuine compliments within 15 minutes, and post a selfie with your favourite reaction in the caption.
Ask a tourist what they love most about their home city, then photograph something in your city that comes close.
Ask a stranger to give you a 30-second lesson in anything they're good at, then film yourself doing what you learned.
Ask a local to tell you something about the street you're standing on, then film yourself retelling it in that spot.
Ask a stranger for the recipe of their favourite simple home dish, cook a version of it today and photograph it.
Do your best runway walk in front of a stranger who agrees to judge it, and post their score with a video of the walk.
Speak only a language that isn't your native one for a whole café visit, from ordering to paying, and post a selfie with your drink.
Ask a stranger for three random words, then film a 30-second speech that uses all three.
Ask a shop assistant to style you in an outfit you would never normally wear, and post one fitting-room photo. No need to buy anything.
Ask a speaker of a language you don't know to teach you how to introduce yourself in it, and film yourself saying it.
Ask a stranger to teach you a simple trick (a coin trick, a card trick, a pen spin), and film yourself performing it.
Ask a stranger to rate your attempt at the local accent while you say one sentence in the local language, and film your best attempt.
Ask a stranger to rate your pick-up line from 1 to 10 and suggest a better one, then post both in the caption.
Get five strangers to give you a high five within ten minutes, and post a selfie with your hand raised and the final count.
Ask a stranger what superpower you look like you'd have, then film yourself acting out that superpower.
Ask a stranger at a bus or tram stop about the best thing that happened to them this week, and post a selfie with their answer in the caption.
Ask a stranger to name a skill you should learn this year, then film your first ever attempt at it.
Ask a market vendor how to pick a perfect piece of their fruit, choose one and photograph it with their tip as the caption.
Spend 15 minutes in a busy spot with a handmade "Free compliments" sign and give at least ten compliments. Post a selfie with the sign.
Sing a full song in a public place (a park, a square, a station hall) loud enough for passers-by to hear, and film the best 60 seconds.
Have a ten-minute conversation with a stranger, learn three real things about them, and post a selfie with the three things in the caption.
Get ten different strangers to each say one word of a sentence you choose on camera, with their OK, and post it as one video.
Collect signatures from 15 strangers on one sheet of paper, each with one word describing you, and photograph the sheet.
Perform a 60-second stand-up comedy set in a public park, and film the whole thing.
Speak only a language that isn't your native one with everyone you talk to for two hours, and post a selfie with a list of everything you said.
Ask a stranger to grab a coffee with you (each paying their own) and talk for at least 20 minutes, then post a photo of your cup and how it went.
Find a stranger born in the same month as you within an hour, and post a selfie with them if they agree, or with their star sign in the caption if not.
Teach a stranger who wants to learn one phrase in your native language, and film them saying it if they agree.
Lead at least three strangers in a ten-second countdown or cheer, and film it if they agree.
Walk 15 km within your city today and post a screenshot of your tracker together with a photo of your feet.
Cook a three-course meal from scratch on a small budget and post one photo of all three courses together.
Recite a dramatic poem in a busy public place, as loudly and seriously as you can, and film it.
Ask a stranger to show you their favourite place nearby (only somewhere public, only if they're happy to), and take a photo there.
Get five strangers to dance with you for ten seconds, and film it if they all agree.
Go alone to a free public event (a talk, an exhibition opening, an open training session) and talk to at least two people there. Post a photo of the event.
Wear an "Ask me anything" sign in a public place for 20 minutes and answer every question honestly. Post a selfie with the sign.
Ask five strangers for one word each, then write a short song using all five and perform it in public on camera.
Give a stranger who agrees a three-minute guided tour of the street you're on, and post a photo or short clip of it with their OK.
Have a real conversation with a stranger that goes well enough for you both to swap contacts, and post a selfie with your new acquaintance if they agree.
Get to a place you've never been by asking strangers for directions only, no maps app, and photograph it when you arrive.
Draw a portrait of a stranger who agrees to sit for five minutes, photograph it, and then give them the drawing.
Ask three strangers for one place each that you must see, visit all three today and post a photo from the last one.
Learn three sentences about yourself in a language you have never studied, then say them to a native speaker and film yourself afterwards saying them again.
Do 100 burpees in a public park in one session and film the last ten.
Busk for ten minutes in a public spot (sing, play, dance or do magic) without asking for money, and film the best 60 seconds.
Ask a group member to send you any song, then choreograph a 45-second dance to it and perform it in a public park.
Make a 60-second mini documentary of your whole day in your city, filmed and narrated for the group.
Explore your city on foot for one hour, filming a 2-second clip every five minutes, and post them as one video for the group.
